create_finetune_dataset: create a fine-tuning dataset from ASE atoms files by converting train and val directories into ASE database format
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer value and linear reference coefficients from a training ASE database file
launch_processing: launch parallel processing to convert ASE atoms files into an ASE database with metadata and logs
write_ase_db: write ASE atoms objects with energy and forces to an ASE database file in parallel
extract_energy_and_forces: extract energy, forces, and atomic numbers from an ASE atoms object at a given dataset index
